summary: Smart Snippets and suggestion interaction improvements

changes.title: App-aware Smart Snippets
changes.detail: Long-press a clipboard text card to configure app targets, daily or session frequency, a fixed time window, and optional empty-field/new-line recovery. Tap a private title to paste; dismiss or choose another matching snippet.

changes.title: Snippet controls and privacy
changes.detail: Manage pinned rules in the keyboard and searchable Clipboard settings, including schedules and custom titles. Rules are encrypted locally without duplicating clipboard text, and protected editors are excluded.

changes.title: Suggestion menu and delete controls
changes.detail: Corrected popup measurement and detached-window guards, outside dismissal and touch forwarding, plus suggestion deletion targets and accessibility. Normal predictions and existing visual motion remain unchanged.

changes.title: Build integration
changes.detail: Use the existing public keyboard and settings accessors without widening IME field visibility.
